> 第883章 暗夜（第1页）
“当初的战火蔓延，我仙古沈家也难以幸免，只不过我们有先祖提前做了准备。”
“这才将一部分族人保留了下来，成为新世界的火种。”
沈小小从碎石堆上跳下来，动作轻盈得像一片枯叶落地。
“而现在，所谓的仙古沈家，早已经是名存实亡。”
“存在于世的，就只有我们的‘暗夜组织。’”
“对你来说，很强。”沈小小抬眸看天，那双空洞的眼眸中倒映着黑日冰冷的轮廓，“但对他来说——不堪一击。”
他当然知道沈小小口中的“他”是谁。
黑日高悬于世，任何仰望苍穹的人都无法忽视那道刻在整个世界头顶的伤疤。
“正因为如此，我们才要反抗。”沈小小的声音很轻，却带着一股不容置疑的决绝，“暗夜之名，本就为此而来——我们行走在无尽黑暗之中，只为给后来者点燃一簇火光。”
萧夜看着她眼中那簇微弱却执拗的火光，忽然想起多年前那个疯掉的老者，想起废墟上分粥给他的那些面黄肌瘦的面孔，想起断成三截的玄天巨剑，想起干涸的海床上那些枯骨。
他活了千年，见过无数残垣断壁，听过无数绝望叹息。
但这是他第一次，在一个人眼中看到还有未灭的希望。
以仙古沈家的部众为首，聚集了一大批当年灾劫的幸存者。
萧夜感受到了自己的渺小，在这里，仙台遍地走，准帝多如狗，甚至还有几位，身上的气息完全深不可测，自己根本不敢靠近。
可即便是这样的阵容，在这黑日笼罩的世界里，依旧只能当潜伏在暗夜里的老鼠，苟且偷生。
沈小小领他穿过层层结界，走过暗夜的地下城池。
城是挖空了整条灵脉残骸建起来的，墙壁上嵌着一层勉强能隔绝黑日吸噬的防御体系。
沈家的先贤们用这种方式维持着自身修为，令其不至于下降的太过迅速，可即便如此，依旧难以抵御黑日的侵蚀。
沈小小的修为是暗夜的中层，她和萧夜讲述了有关暗夜的一切，萧夜也因此得知了，暗夜的首领乃是曾经沈家的一名贵女，不过可惜，以他的身份地位目前还没有见她的资格，不过萧夜并没有颓丧，一颗种子在他的心头埋下。
黑日之下，除了给生命带来灾难，还会创造出诡异的怪物，清扫部队的任务就是剿灭这些怪物。
在末法时代，这是最危险的行当——黑日压制之下，修士的神识范围被压缩到极致，行走在外界之时只能靠两条腿走，靠两只眼睛看。
每次外出执行任务，都是一场与时间赛跑的赌博。
黑日对灵力的吸噬无时无刻不在进行，在外待得越久，体内灵力流失越快，一旦灵力见底，黑日的吸噬便会直接作用于血肉与神魂，将一个大活人活活吸成一具干尸。
他的眼睛与众不同，能在无尽黑暗中捕捉到残留的灵力脉络，这份天赋让他很快崭露头角。
斩杀诡异怪物不仅能还天地朗朗乾坤，还能捕捉那些怪物死亡时逸散的部分灵力提升自己，凭借着这一契机，萧夜的实力飞快的提升着。

> Chapter 883 Dark Night (Page 1)
"When the war spread, our Immortal Shen family was not immune, but our ancestors made preparations in advance."
"This is how some tribesmen were preserved and became the fire of the new world."
Shen Xiaoxiao jumped down from the gravel pile, his movements as light as a dead leaf falling to the ground.
"But now, the so-called Immortal Shen family has long existed in name only."
"The only thing that exists in the world is our 'Dark Night Organization.'"
"For you, it's very strong." Shen Xiaoxiao looked up at the sky, his empty eyes reflecting the cold outline of the black sun, "But for him - vulnerable."
Of course he knew who "he" Shen Xiaoxiao was talking about.
The black sun hangs high in the world, and anyone looking up at the sky cannot ignore the scar carved on the head of the entire world.
"That's why we have to resist." Shen Xiaoxiao's voice was very soft, but with an unquestionable determination, "The name of the dark night comes from this - we walk in the endless darkness, just to ignite a bunch of fire for those who come after us."
Xiao Ye looked at the weak but stubborn fire in her eyes, and suddenly thought of the crazy old man many years ago, the sallow and thin faces who distributed porridge to him on the ruins, the Xuantian giant sword broken into three pieces, and the withered bones on the dry seabed.
He has lived for thousands of years, seen countless ruins, and heard countless despairing sighs.
But this was the first time he saw hope in someone's eyes.
Led by members of the Immortal Shen family, a large number of survivors of the disaster were gathered.
Xiao Ye felt his own insignificance. Here, there were as many quasi-emperors as dogs everywhere in the immortal platform, and there were even a few of them. The aura on their bodies was completely unfathomable, and he did not dare to approach them at all.
But even with such a lineup, in this world shrouded in darkness, they can still only survive as rats lurking in the dark night.
Shen Xiaoxiao led him through layers of barriers and through the underground city in the dark night.
The city was built by hollowing out the remains of the entire spiritual vein. The walls were embedded with a layer of defense system that could barely block the black sun.
The sages of the Shen family used this method to maintain their cultivation level, preventing it from declining too quickly, but even so, it was still difficult to resist the erosion of the black sun.
Shen Xiaoxiao's cultivation is in the middle level of An Ye. She told Xiao Ye everything about An Ye, and Xiao Ye also learned that the leader of An Ye was a noble daughter of the Shen family. Unfortunately, due to his status, he was not qualified to meet her. However, Xiao Ye was not depressed, and a seed was planted in his heart.
Under the dark sun, in addition to bringing disaster to life, it will also create strange monsters. The task of the cleanup troops is to destroy these monsters.
In the age of the end of the Dharma, this is the most dangerous profession - under the suppression of the black sun, the scope of the monk's spiritual consciousness is compressed to the extreme. When walking in the outside world, he can only walk on two legs and see with two eyes.
Every time you go out on a mission, it's a gamble against time.
Black Sun's sucking of spiritual power is going on all the time. The longer you stay outside, the faster the spiritual power in your body will be lost. Once the spiritual power reaches the bottom, Black Sun's sucking will directly act on the flesh, flesh and soul, sucking a living person into a mummy alive.
His eyes were unique and could capture the remaining spiritual energy in the endless darkness. This talent made him stand out quickly.
Killing strange monsters can not only bring peace to the world, but also capture part of the spiritual power that escapes when those monsters die to improve themselves. With this opportunity, Xiao Ye's strength has rapidly improved.
